descriptor: Quick notes app with a one-thumb menu

voice.summary: Pocket Notes sounds like a clear-headed friend jotting things down next to you. It keeps labels to one word, states each action as a verb and trusts the thumb more than the manual.
dos: Use single-word action labels: pin, share, delete
Describe keyboard shortcuts in one sentence
Show the result of an action immediately
donts: Avoid menus nested more than one level

taglines: Tap once, fan out five actions
boilerplate: Pocket Notes is a minimalist notes app whose floating radial menu puts pin, share, tag, archive and delete within a single thumb's reach.

microcopy.error: Could not save the note. Try again.
microcopy.empty: No notes yet. Tap the round button to add one.

logo.note: A dial echoes the round button and the arc of actions it fans out.
